summary: Markets opened cautiously on Monday, with equities edging higher ahead of major technology earnings while the AI trade weakened, crude oil declined, and Bitcoin slipped below $80,000.[2][4] Crypto sentiment is mixed: Michael van de Poppe described the Bitcoin dip as a long-term buying opportunity relative to gold, while Ted Pillows warned that a weekly break below $80,000 could trigger capitulation.[10]
